# Secrets a pull-request-reachable job REFERENCES but that no preflight in this repository can
# assert. Read by the platform's `check-pr-secret-preflight.py`, which repo-hygiene.yml runs
# against this tree (Systemorph/MeshWeaver#3399, #3576).
#
# Format: `NAME  # why this name is passed but never consumed here` — the reason is mandatory and
# must say something (at least 12 characters). The guard also refuses a STALE entry: a name no
# pull-request job references any more is a violation, so an exemption dies with the thing it
# exempted rather than outliving it.
#
# The bar for an entry is NOT "this secret is inconvenient to assert". It is "asserting it here
# would be weaker than what already asserts it", which is true of exactly one shape: a name
# forwarded into a REUSABLE lane whose own preflight tests it. The guard is static and cannot see
# through a `uses:`; the lane can, and does, in the store the run actually resolves against.

MESHWEAVER_APP_ID  # forwarded by auto-arm.yml into the platform's reusable auto-arm.yml lane, whose own first step asserts it non-empty and fails RED naming it — in the store the run actually resolves against
MESHWEAVER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY  # forwarded by auto-arm.yml into the platform's reusable auto-arm.yml lane, whose own first step asserts it non-empty and fails RED naming it — in the store the run actually resolves against
